name: Decision Trees
learningObjectives: Understand how decision trees make predictions using rules
Learn about splitting criteria (Gini impurity, entropy)
Explore the impact of tree depth on overfitting
Recognize the importance of pruning for generalization
Understand feature importance in decision trees

controls.label: Max Tree Depth
controls.tooltip: Maximum depth of the tree. Deeper trees can model more complex patterns but may overfit.

controls.label: Min Samples to Split
controls.tooltip: Minimum number of samples required to split a node. Higher values prevent overfitting.

visualizations.title: Decision Tree Structure
visualizations.description: Visual representation of the learned decision tree

visualizations.title: Decision Boundary
visualizations.description: Scatter plot showing data points and tree decision regions

visualizations.title: Feature Importance
visualizations.description: Bar chart showing relative importance of each feature

metrics.name: Precision
metrics.description: Of predicted positives, how many are actually positive

metrics.name: Recall
metrics.description: Of actual positives, how many were correctly predicted

metrics.name: F1 Score
metrics.description: Harmonic mean of precision and recall
